name: get_total_item_count

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_GetTotalItemCount replaces the top item ID with the sum of the stock byte at D_003010F8 + 0x499 + item_id and matching item IDs in the four character item-slot lists

notes: The result includes both unequipped stock and copies held in character item slots. The JP corpus contains 60 calls, all in pc06.ard with literal item IDs 178 through 185; every result is immediately stored, and 24 are tested against zero within the next 20 instructions.
